name: Sutter Health
notes: Researched from the public sutterhealth.org Billing and insurance page and its FAQs (no sign-in, no guest lookup). Sign in to My Health Online (MHO, Epic MyChart) to view and pay hospital or doctor bills; Guest Pay lets patients and family pay without an MHO account (Sansum Clinic patients use Sansum MyChart). Online payments: Visa, MasterCard, Discover or American Express credit cards, including HSA cards on those networks; no bank/e-check option is listed, so methods are card-only. Mail a check on receipt of the bill; phone payments via the local billing office (Contact Us). Payment plans: eligible patients set them up for doctor services in MHO (View / Pay / Print Bill > Set Up Payment Plan, choosing amount, method and date) or through the billing office for doctor or hospital services; ask about eligibility at 800-4SUTTER (800-478-8837). Automatic discounts, financial assistance. Detailed bills in MHO > Billing > Account Details. Estimates: hospital 855-398-1637, doctor 866-961-8566. Paper statements can take over a week to print and mail, so a recent online payment may only appear on the next statement. Future copays can be pre-authorized on a card that is charged at check-in. AutoPay and paperless are not described (family defaults kept; autopay methodTypes card-only to match). Reviewer (2026-10-10): 855-398-1633 (catalog number) is Patient Financial Services on the Sutter financial assistance page; added to the assistance article, contact stays 800-4SUTTER. Hospital plans are interest-free per the hospital financial assistance policy summary. Phone payments go through the local billing office listed on Sutter's Contact Us page.

payment_arrangement.note: Online plans are for qualifying doctor-services balances. For hospital bills or to check eligibility, call 800-4SUTTER (800-478-8837).

help.title: How to pay your Sutter bill
paragraphs: The quickest way to pay is online in My Health Online (MHO): sign in to view and pay hospital or doctor bills. You and your family can also use Guest Pay without an MHO account. Sansum Clinic patients pay in Sansum's MyChart.
Online payments are made with a Visa, MasterCard, Discover or American Express credit card, including HSA cards on those networks.
You can also mail a check when you receive your bill, or call your local billing office (see Contact Us).
A paper statement can take more than a week to print and mail. If you pay online in that time, the payment is applied but shows on your next statement.

help.title: Payment plans
paragraphs: Sutter offers payment plans, automatic discounts and financial assistance. To learn whether you qualify for a plan, call 800-4SUTTER.

If you have a qualifying balance for doctor services, you can set up a plan in MHO: open View / Pay / Print Bill, choose Set Up Payment Plan, then pick the payment amount, method and date. For hospital services, contact the billing office.
steps: Open View / Pay / Print Bill from the menu.
Choose Set Up Payment Plan next to a qualifying balance.
Select the payment amount, method and date.

help.title: Help paying your bill
paragraphs: Sutter Health has hospital, medical group and pharmacy financial assistance programs, and applies some discounts automatically. For price estimates call Sutter Health Patient Advocates: 855-398-1637 for hospital fees or 866-961-8566 for doctor fees.
For questions about hospital financial assistance or to apply with a representative, call Patient Financial Services at 855-398-1633. Sutter hospital payment plans carry no interest.

help.title: Billing questions
paragraphs: For billing questions or billing records, use Sutter's online chat or call 800-4SUTTER (800-478-8837) and choose the Billing option, Monday through Friday, 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. For a detailed bill, open MHO, Billing, Account Details, or call the number on your statement.

extra.intent: Using Sutter Health's billing FAQs, find what kind of payment method Sutter accepts for online bill payments. Do not make a payment or change anything.

solution.text: A Visa, MasterCard, Discover or American Express credit card (including HSA cards on those networks).
